C0381.title: Photo Studio Anniversary Recharge Scam Ends in Closure and Flight, Professional Closer Sentenced
C0381.summary: A photo studio in Ningbo, Zhejiang, lured long-time members like Wang Xue into recharging for a grand prize under the guise of an anniversary event. After collecting over 1.4 million yuan in prepayments, staff blocked customers and shut down the business. Investigation revealed the studio was taken over by Zheng at zero cost and manipulated by a planning company specializing in defrauding consumer
